title: Asian Games: China's Yu Zidi wins third swim gold with latest record

blocks.text: TOKYO–China’s 13-year-old swimming sensation Yu Zidi completed a hat-trick of Asian Games 2026 golds on Wednesday with a dominant victory in the 400m individual medley, two years out from the Los Angeles Olympics. The school girl powered home in an Asian Games-record 4 minutes 28.56 seconds to make it a clean sweep from her three individual events in Tokyo, following victories in the 200m butterfly and 200m individual medley, also in Games-record times.
